action_templates.billing: Reply: confirm the billing question about '{subject}', attach the invoice/charge breakdown, offer a refund path if overcharged.
action_templates.shipping: Reply: locate the order '{subject}', provide tracking, confirm the delivery ETA.
action_templates.security: Reply: verify the requester's identity first, then unlock/reset access for '{subject}'; never send credentials in the reply.
action_templates.support: Reply: acknowledge '{subject}', ask for the missing detail, and route it to the right team.
action_templates.general: Reply: acknowledge '{subject}', ask one clarifying question, then route it to the right queue.
